purpose: Use the permanently burned M2h engineering markets to determine whether a sufficiently frequent and executable external-sharp-versus-Polymarket dislocation exists to justify spending existing quota on a targeted high-frequency pilot. M3a is exploratory development analysis and cannot establish H2-v2 profitability.

development_set.definition: Exactly the nine distinct odds_game_id values present in the frozen M2h tape.
development_set.reason: These markets were repeatedly used to engineer and validate the H2-v2 data and replay infrastructure.

strategy_semantics.fair_probability: consensus_prob from the sharp observation at decision time

fee_model.fee_rate_source: market-specific fee_rate captured in the frozen M2h tape
fee_model.p: corresponding executable share price between 0 and 1
required_pre_analysis_checks: fee_rate is present for every row
fee_exponent is present for every row
taker_only is present for every row
captured fee configuration is internally consistent across a market
no economic outputs are produced if the captured configuration indicates the frozen fee formula is inappropriate

threshold_trade_rule.entry_selection: For each market and each candidate threshold independently, select the earliest chronological observation at which a liquidity-valid outcome satisfies the threshold.
threshold_trade_rule.same_timestamp_multiple_outcomes: Choose the outcome with the larger execution_edge.

resolution_analysis.if_resolution_is_missing_or_ambiguous: Do not infer it. Report incomplete economic outcomes while still completing non-resolution structural diagnostics.

latency: count of positive decision edges remaining positive after 500ms
count of threshold crossings surviving to the execution endpoint
threshold_economics_if_resolved: market-equal mean net PnL per share

m3a_progression_gate.name: STRUCTURAL_EXECUTABLE_SIGNAL
m3a_progression_gate.definition: At least three of the nine frozen development markets must contain at least one liquidity-valid observation with execution_edge >= 1.0%.
m3a_progression_gate.reason: The immediate funding decision is whether an executable dislocation appears repeatedly across independent development markets. Nine-market realized PnL is too small and noisy to be the primary gate.

if_promising_for_m3b.next_experiment: Targeted development-only high-frequency sharp collection using existing quota.

if_not_promising_for_m3b.next_action: Reassess the hypothesis, sharp-feed latency, fair-value construction, or direct-exchange-feed architecture as a new preregistered experiment.

formal_h2_v2_design_unchanged.formal_calibration_no_go_rule: If no candidate threshold with at least 20 trades has positive calibration mean net PnL, do not start confirmatory OOS without declaring a new hypothesis.

prohibited: Do not count the nine development markets toward the 60-market calibration.
Do not count the nine development markets toward the 100-market OOS.
Do not select a production threshold from M3a.
Do not alter the candidate threshold grid after M3a.
Do not alter the M3a progression gate after seeing results.
Do not exclude an unfavorable development market.
Do not call M3a evidence proof of profitability.
Do not buy additional API quota as part of M3a.
Do not make new Odds API calls as part of M3a.
